description: A method argument type error in a feature condition reports its owning directive (engine §§10, 13).

documents.p.md:
```jbogenbau
%stage first
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text A
%emits
%stage second
%features f
%conditions $.value.split(A) = ∅
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text f? A

```
